Support monitoring, logging, and observability solutions for platform health and performance. Support Kubernetes security, networking, traffic management, and troubleshooting in production environments. Strong experience with Kubernetes orchestration, including networking, security, and scaling concepts. Experience deploying and operating Kubernetes workloads in AWS. Strong Linux administration, networking, and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in Helm for packaging and deploying Kubernetes applications. Familiarity with Service Mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Consul) for networking and security. It plays an important role in international affairs through diplomacy, trade, development aid and working with global organizations. Abroad, the EU is represented through more than 140 diplomatic representations, known also as EU Delegations, which have a similar function to those of an embassy. The EU Delegation to the Republic of South Africa works in close coordination with the Embassies and Consulates of the 27 EU Member States. We are a fully-fledged diplomatic mission and represent the European Union in dealings with the South African government in areas that are part of the EU’s remit. We offer The post of Budget Officer (Local Agent Group I) in the Regional Hub Southern Africa under a fixed-term employment contract of 2 years, with a possibility of renewal under reserve of budgetary availabilities and operational considerations. For internal candidates holding an indefinite-term contract, alternative contractual arrangements may apply in accordance with institutional policies. The team consists of 44 people and there are occasional atypical working hours. Under this post, the recruited person will be attributed functions depending on the needs of the Delegation, and on the changes of these needs. The successful candidate will serve under the supervision and responsibility of the Head of Regional Partnerships Unit, providing support, expertise and assistance in financial management of EU - financed programmes and projects at regional level and in the Kingdom of Lesotho, ensuring conformity with procedures for contracting, financing, and on-the-spot controls. Ensuring compliance with the financial regulations, internal rules and local fiscal requirements. Providing advice on contractual, financial, budgetary and fiscal matters. Encoding, processing and follow up of transactions in the corporate IT systems. Financial planning, budgeting, reporting, audits, and verification on project / contracts / programs. Preparation and follow-up of audit and control plans for programs and projects, including on-the-spot checks and verification missions. Preparation and verification of tender dossiers and documents for calls for proposals. Participation in evaluation committees. The base salary will depend on relevant and verified employment experience, typically starting from ZAR78,046.00. There is a competitive benefits package, subject to certain conditions, including personal leave days and public holidays, health insurances and a retirement savings plan. Professional experience must be acquired after the date on which the qualification allowing access to the post was obtained. Working knowledge (B2) of English Right to residence and work in South Africa. Assets/selection criteria (basis for awarding points to select the best applicant) Master’s degree in accounting / finance / Project management Certification: Fraud Prevention / Financial Investigation / Development cooperation Professional experience in diplomatic mission, international financial institution or international development agency French and / or Sesotho language, OPSYS, CRIS, ABAC, SUMMA Knowledge/experience of EU policies, in the Kingdom of Lesotho How To Apply The applicant must apply by sending a cover letter, signed a Curriculum Vitæ (to include, at the minimum, exact job titles, employer’s names and detailed tasks descriptions) using one of the Europass template available at: https://europass.europa.eu/en all documents to the following email address: eeasjobs-221@eeas.europa.eu And mention in the email subject: “Ref: 514366 – Budget Officer” no later than 18:00 hours (UTC+02:00) 18/09/2026. At least the 3 best candidates will be invited to the final interview. Only candidates admitted to each successive selection phase will be contacted individually. The Delegation will not supply additional information or discuss the selection procedure. During the selection process, please do not contact the members of the Selection Committee, but address your questions and comments to the Delegation’s Administration. The successful candidate will be subject to a medical check and possible background check. review_candidates.description: At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence. If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity. Skills And Competencies The individual should have a minimum of 10 years of relevant analytical experience, predominantly in a credit role A strong and seasoned team player and clear culture fit is a key priority for this hire. The individual must collaborate effectively not only with their manager but also with peers and team colleagues, and work seamlessly across the franchise geographically and across teams, building trust and consensus Posses demonstrable track record of external outreach and public speaking is essential. The individual is expected to have experience presenting at, moderating, or speaking on panels at industry conferences, investor forums, and client events, with the confidence and presence to represent the franchise credibly before senior external audiences and the media Has solid understanding of the Infrastructure, utility, and project finance sectors, preferably in South & Southeast Asia (SSEA), and ideally extending to digital infrastructure, transition, and complex or credit-enhanced structures, together with the operating-environment and cultural knowledge these markets require A proactive, creative problem-solver on complex analytical challenges who retains a clear, independent and yet, open-minded perspective Strong writing skills, deep subject-matter knowledge, and the ability to turn data into clear visual narratives and articulate complex credit concepts simply Ability to multitask and respond to changing priorities, balancing research and outreach with daily transaction and surveillance work Exceptional interpersonal skills, professionalism, and diplomacy to manage issuer and stakeholder relationships at the most senior levels Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use. Education A graduate degree in finance, banking, economics, corporate finance, or a related discipline, with postgraduate qualifications being a plus Responsibilities The Vice President will provide senior analytical judgement and execution on the credit quality of rated entities and debt instruments, including rated projects and corporates in the infrastructure and power/utilities sectors within ASEAN and South Asia. There will be a particular focus on higher-complexity mandates across digital infrastructure, transition, and emerging and frontier markets. The individual will manage frequent interaction with investors, intermediaries, and issuers, including at the most senior levels, and represent the franchise in market-facing outreach. The Vice President will also write comprehensive, insightful, and thought-provoking research and conduct outreach on a broader regional basis. Senior analytical leadership on complex credits  The Role Anchors The Region's Highest-complexity Mandates Intersecting a Variety Of Themes Ranging From Transition, Emerging Markets, Blended Finance To Private Credit And Digital Infrastructure: Act as lead analyst on higher-complexity project and infrastructure finance credits, owning senior analytical judgement and execution, including transition-related mandates such as renewables, grid, and storage across ASEAN and India and digital infrastructure (data centres and GPUs). Represent the franchise in senior-level outreach, including speaking engagements at industry conferences and forums and targeted issuer, investor, and market-facing meetings where VP-level credibility is required, raising franchise visibility and anchoring relationships with top issuers, policy makers, and intermediaries. Outreach  The Role Acts As a Senior External Voice For The Franchise, Building Trusted Relationships And Representing Moody's Ratings In The Market: Communicate confidently with external parties, manage senior internal and external stakeholder relationships, and handle sensitive information with discretion. Deliver insightful presentations and panel interventions at conferences, industry events, and key stakeholder meetings, where relevant. Leadership and collaboration  Being a Genuine Team Player Is Central To This Role, Which Builds a High-performing Team By Collaborating With Peers And Less Experienced Colleagues, Partnering Across The Franchise Geographically And Across Teams, And Leading Through Influence: Take an active role in strategic projects that strengthen team effectiveness across the region. Build constructive working relationships and consensus with peers, junior colleagues, and diverse team members across locations and teams, leading by influence rather than authority.  Provide leadership, coaching, and mentoring to less experienced team members, actively contributing to a supportive and inclusive team culture. Timely Research  The role drives the franchise's published thought leadership, turning credit views into insightful research that shapes the market conversation: Produce clear, insightful research on individual companies and industry sectors. Create compelling company- and sector-related content, including credit reports, sector comments, infographics, and industry outlooks. About The Team Our Project & Infrastructure Finance team is responsible for the accurate ratings of our portfolio of issuers and debt instruments, including rated projects and corporates in the infrastructure and power/utilities sectors within ASEAN and South Asia. By joining our team, you will be undertaking analysis and producing research which enhances transparency in the financial markets, thus facilitating the financing of essential infrastructure in Emerging Asia. We are a cohesive, close-knit unit that works as one, sharing need-to-know information intuitively, supporting one another through peak workloads, and taking collective pride in the quality of our analysis. A strong team spirit underpins how we operate day-to-day. Because this cohesion is central to how we succeed, it is essential that any new addition adds to the team's esprit-de-corps rather than subtracts from it — someone who elevates those around them, collaborates generously, and strengthens the collective spirit of the group. Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. Risk Management, Limit Monitoring & System Implementation Limit Setup & Monitoring: Set up, monitor, and enforce exposure and stop-loss limits across treasury activities, providing regular performance and utilization reports to senior leadership. Breach Management: In the event of an exposure or stop-loss limit breach, proactively seek immediate trade ratification and formulate a concrete action plan to bring utilization back within limits. Report breach summaries and subsequent progress to senior management. Risk Analytics: Analyze and control the risk of treasury dealings. Calculate, analyze, and report Value at Risk (VaR) on a regular basis. Stress Testing: Run forward-looking forecasts and simulations using sensitivity analysis and stress testing to provide deep insights into potential portfolio impacts. System Implementation & Reporting: Provide business and risk intelligence to management to assist in the implementation of advanced risk management systems. 2. Trade Execution Control, Valuations & Mandates Execution Source Control: Monitor and control trade execution channels (such as FXGo, Bloomberg Chat, or official Voice calls). Escalate any unauthorized trade execution sources immediately. Dealer Mandates: Maintain up-to-date dealer mandates and ensure that all treasury transactions are executed in strict accordance with corporate authorization rules. P&L Computation: Compute and publish daily Profit and Loss (PnL) statements for all trading / risk management desks of Group Treasury. Valuation & MTM Reconciliation: Ensure the absolute correctness of trade valuations by assessing and testing the pricing methodologies utilized by the FinMechanics (FM) system. 3. Hedging, Debt Documentation & DCM Coordination Risk quantification: Actively monitor and report quantum of Risk run by desk and ad well as Group along with sensitivity and scenarios. Covenant Tracking & Monitoring: Set up, maintain, and manage a robust tracking framework to monitor compliance with financial, operational, and hedging covenants under existing and new debt documents (including USD Bonds, ECBs, FCLs, and bilateral bank facilities). Ensure zero defaults by proactively flagging covenant headroom risks to senior management. Economic Value of Treasury Activities: Actively analyze, quantify and report on the economic value of Treasury decisions. Hedge Cost Benchmarking: Track, analyze, and publish actual hedge costs against benchmark hedge costs for USD Bonds, External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs), and Foreign Currency Loans (FCLs) on a regular basis. DCM Documentation: Coordinate with key internal and external stakeholders—including legal teams, lead managers, and BUs—to timely execute Debt Capital Markets (DCM) documentation. 4. Audit Compliance Audit Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for the internal audit team. Ensure swift resolution of audit findings and establish clear, time-bound action plans to address any noted control gaps. * Qualifications and Experience Education: Chartered Accountant (CA), Financial Risk Management (FRM), CFA, or MBA in Finance from a premier institution. Experience: 5 to 9 years of direct experience in a Treasury Middle Office, Treasury Control, or Market Risk department within a large multinational conglomerate, major bank, or financial institution.

Provide analytical support to the Senior Manager – Distribution & Channels on agent liquidity insights, channel performance, market execution, partner performance and operational decision-making. Analyze agent performance by classification, territory, region, cohort, transaction value, transaction volume, commission earnings, activity levels and liquidity support intensity, and recommend actions to grow active agents and protect high-value agents. Track and report performance of liquidity channels including Dealers, Super Agents, Trust Banks, Distributor Rebalancers and other rebalancing partners to ensure agents have reliable access to float and cash. Monitor the execution, performance and progress of Super Agent and rebalancing initiatives, including agent mapping, working capital availability, route coverage, distributor rebalancers productivity, frequency of rebalancing, unique agents served, value supplied, off-peak support and SLA adherence. Prepare structured insights and management reports highlighting operational risks, liquidity constraints, partner performance gaps, agent pain points, customer impact and recommended corrective actions. Work closely with MoMo Business Intelligence to automate dashboards, standardize reporting definitions, improve data quality and ensure timely delivery of Distribution & Channels reports to leadership and regional teams. Support field teams with actionable data for daily execution, including regional performance packs, agent cohort watchlists, Top 20% agent support lists, low-performing agent recovery lists and priority liquidity intervention areas. Ability to conduct territory, route, site and cohort-level performance analysis. Strong knowledge of agent onboarding, KYC, agent regularization, customer due diligence and compliance processes. Ability to identify operational risks, fraud indicators, process gaps and control weaknesses in the distribution ecosystem. Good business modelling skills to support commercial proposals, incentive models, liquidity expansion, route optimization and partner performance evaluation. Strong project tracking and action management skills, including ownership tracking, timelines, dependencies, risks and status reporting. Good presentation and business writing skills for executive reports, management packs and stakeholder updates. Results-oriented, proactive and able to operate under pressure with tight deadlines. Collaborative team player able to work across Commercial, Sales, Finance Operations, Technology, Risk and Compliance teams. Agent onboarding, KYC, regularization and training tracker. Fraud, gaming, process gap and operational risk escalation tracker. Management action tracker with owners, due dates, progress and closure status. NB: Presentation of false academic documents and certification will lead to criminal prosecution.
